reviews.text: Nothing to say about Mohamed, but about the washer and groomer, yes. I took my 1.5-year-old dog to be washed a few days ago. When we got home, one of his eyes started to become inflamed. Conjunctivitis? No! He has a large lesion on his cornea, and after two weeks of antibiotics and eye drops, he'll have to have surgery if it hasn't cleared up (diagnosis by a specialist recommended by Mohamed himself). What happened during the bath? They wouldn't tell me. Don't take dogs to be washed there! The specialist claims that a liquid unsuitable for washing got into the eye, as the lesion is very large.

I called for an ultrasound and any tests. I explained that I have a problematic dog and he told me to go to the previous doctor... it's as if a pediatrician told a mother that she should take a child who is afraid of doctors home...

Aside from Dr. Ganimeh's undisputed professionalism, I truly appreciated the kindness, patience, and generous support shown by his son and the other veterinarian who came to my house this morning and, after spending considerable time with her, helped me bring my dog ​​to the clinic and bring her home.
All this was done with the utmost care and a clear love for animals, which truly impressed me and which is not always the hallmark of professionals in the field.

Dr. Mohamed and his son are very kind, helpful, and knowledgeable. But the medical staff who work alongside them are arrogant and arrogant people. They are always unprepared, and procedures that I've managed to get from them elsewhere are insurmountable problems, so they say they can't be done. Before you go, make sure Dr. Mohamed is there.

A truly positive experience! I immediately felt welcomed and reassured. My dog ​​was treated with great kindness and professionalism. The visit was thorough, with clear explanations and attention to every detail. The office is clean and well-organized, and you can sense a true passion for animals. I will definitely be back and highly recommend it! Lucia Palmisciano

I took my dog ​​for a checkup and was extremely satisfied with the service I received. The clinic is clean, tidy, and well-organized, with a welcoming waiting room and short wait times.

The staff was very friendly from the start: the receptionist was available to schedule the appointment promptly, and the doctor who examined my dog ​​was professional, empathetic, and clear in her explanations. She immediately put us at ease, treating the animal with gentleness and respect.

I also really appreciated the transparency regarding costs and the willingness to provide practical advice on nutrition and prevention.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a professional yet humane environment, where the animal's well-being comes first.

Review ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ – Finally a serious and humane practice!

After visiting several veterinary practices, often faced with inflated estimates, sketchy diagnoses, and a lack of compassion, I finally found Ambulatorio Veterinario Caracciolo… and I wouldn't change it for anything in the world!

From the first meeting, I knew I was in safe hands. The staff is extremely professional, helpful, and above all honest—qualities that are unfortunately increasingly rare in this field. Each visit is approached with care, empathy, and clarity: no unnecessary alarmism, no superfluous treatments, only what is truly necessary for the animal's well-being.

Unlike other past experiences, where presenting the bill seemed more important than treating my dog, here I found a team that puts the animal first, with a true love for their work. The doctors explain every step, listen patiently, and never make you feel like a number.

I highly recommend Ambulatory Caracciolo to anyone seeking expertise, transparency, and respect. After so many disappointments, finally a reliable source for the health of our four-legged friends!
